item.title: Yoshida Udon: Fujiyoshida's Famously Firm, Chewy Noodles — Guide
item.description: Yoshida udon, a specialty of Fujiyoshida at the foot of Mount Fuji, is renowned for having some of the firmest, chewiest udon noodles in all of Japan, a texture so distinctively robust that it has become the dish’s defining characteristic. Typically served in a broth blending miso and soy sauce, topped with boiled cabbage, sometimes horse meat, and a spicy condiment called suridane, the dish is often found at simple, family-run shops, some operating out of private homes with limited lunchtime hours, giving it a genuinely local, unpretentious character.
